Clarified conditional execution, batching of route calls, and fallback behavior when partial site data exists.

change_log.value: Expanded to include contract validation, tool_router integration, and external API mocking strategy.

stories.title: Define Clinical Trials Search Schema and Contract
stories.description: Define request and response schema for clinical trials search including condition, location, recruiting status, structured trial metadata, eligibility summary normalization, and optional travel metrics. Ensure compatibility with tool_router validation and facade outputs.

stories.title: Implement ClinicalTrials.gov Search Logic
stories.description: Implement ClinicalTrials.gov API integration with recruiting filter, condition/location query handling, structured parsing of trial data, eligibility summary normalization, trial site extraction, pagination handling, retry/backoff for rate limits, and error handling for malformed or partial responses.

stories.title: Add Travel Distance and Time Enrichment
stories.description: Add optional travel distance and duration enrichment using Google Routes API based on user location and trial sites, including batching of route requests, conditional execution when location is present, and graceful fallback when site or route data is incomplete or API fails.

stories.title: Expose Clinical Trials Search via Evaluate Care Facade
stories.description: Expose clinical trials search via EvaluateCare facade and tool router with validated inputs, strict schema enforcement, structured output formatting, and compatibility with Anthropic tool-use patterns per GOV-004.

stories.title: Unit and Integration Tests for Clinical Trials Search
stories.description: Create unit and integration tests covering API fetch, parsing, eligibility normalization, pagination, travel enrichment, facade-level response validation, tool_router integration, and edge cases including empty results, malformed responses, timeouts, and external API failures using mocks.
